correctness.rationale: For all mu,kappa>0, direct differentiation proves constancy of H=(x^2+y^2)/(1+2mu y-kappa y^2); the exact conic equations separate two elliptic regions from hyperbolic ones. The exact angular-time integral supplies periods 2pi and 2pi mu/sqrt(mu^2+kappa). On invariant y-root lines the Riccati equations integrate to the claimed Fminus and Fplus. The invariant parabolic equation reduces to an explicitly integrable positive quartic in x and produces Fpar=2pi mu/sqrt(q). Its leading quartic term gives exponent 1/3. Hyperbolic conics imply the asymptotic y-cubic equation and exponent 1/2; root-line Riccati dynamics give exponent 1. All maximal lifetimes on nonperiodic orbits are finite. The included SymPy checker verifies the critical identities; numerical checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The natural global boundary of a second period annulus is a parabola with finite physical traversal time exactly equal to its bounded periodic orbits, and the two independent invariant line flights sum and differ to the two periods. This quantitatively bridges center theory with escape at infinity, which is invisible to topological orbital classification. The three sharp blowup normalizations distinguish all nonperiodic orbit strata and have a clear role in understanding the boundary. The value rests on exact natural observables of the full two-parameter family rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
